desc: Fluorescent serpent: coiled body of white light-tube segments with gold clamps, a round black void head with one big eye and a smirk, a small cardboard box on its back. Living Backrooms creature, cute chibi but cool, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no shadow. Yellow wallpaper, cardboard brown, lavender, gold palette.
